labels.name: role: both
labels.description: Owned by the designer and developer together

milestones.name: Foundations
milestones.description: Sales call capture, pre-work, repo/Vercel/AI SDK setup, branded components, hackathon briefing.

issues.title: Week 0: Sales handover
ac: All Week 0 sub-issues are closed

subIssues.title: Sales call transcribed and recorded
ac: Sales call recording and transcript are saved where the team can access them

subIssues.title: Excalidraw board exported
ac: Excalidraw board export is shared with the team

issues.title: Day 0: Project set-up
ac: All Day 0 sub-issues are closed

subIssues.title: Scaffold app cloned from GitHub, renamed and set up correctly
ac: Project repo is created from the MVV App Template, renamed, and runs locally

subIssues.title: Pre-work brief reviewed
ac: Both team members have read the pre-work brief

subIssues.title: Sales call recording and Excalidraw reviewed, if needed
ac: Both team members have reviewed the sales call and Excalidraw board, or agreed it isn't needed

subIssues.title: Project set up in personal Claude with all relevant context uploaded
ac: A Claude project exists with the brief, transcript and Excalidraw export uploaded

subIssues.title: FigJam template duplicated
ac: A copy of the FigJam workshop template exists for this project

subIssues.title: "Questions" section of the FigJam workshop board pre-filled
ac: The Questions section of the FigJam board holds the team's questions for the client

subIssues.title: HTML roadmap set up for final day, Hackathon → Feedback stage
ac: HTML roadmap covers the Hackathon through to the Feedback stage

subIssues.title: Vercel link set up for the MVV project app
ac: App deploys to a Vercel URL the team can open

subIssues.title: Branded component guide set up
ac: Component guide uses the client's brand colours, type and logo

subIssues.title: Branded components implemented in the MVV app
ac: App components use the client's brand tokens

subIssues.title: Vercel AI SDK, OpenRouter and OpenRouter .env key implemented
ac: A test AI call through OpenRouter returns a response in the app
The OpenRouter key is set in .env.local and Vercel, and is not committed

subIssues.title: Announcement created on Basecamp
ac: Kick-off announcement is posted on the project's Basecamp

subIssues.title: Hackathon briefing meeting held
ac: Briefing meeting is held and the hackathon plan is agreed

milestones.name: Hackathon
milestones.description: Client interview, WOW moments, briefs, daily build + EOD updates, POC polish and reflections.

issues.title: Day 1: Discovery and WOW briefs
ac: All Day 1 sub-issues are closed

subIssues.title: Key flows and client interview held
ac: Client interview is held and key flows are captured on the FigJam board

subIssues.title: Individual synthesis done
ac: Each team member has written up their synthesis of the interview

subIssues.title: Task 1: WOW moments mind-mapped
ac: Each team member has mind-mapped their WOW moments on the FigJam board

subIssues.title: Task 1: Final 3 WOW moments agreed
ac: The team has agreed the final 3 WOW moments

subIssues.title: Task 2: Lightning demos done
ac: Lightning demos are captured on the FigJam board

subIssues.title: Task 3: How Might We done
ac: How Might We notes are captured and grouped on the FigJam board

subIssues.title: Task 4: WOW 1 brief drafted and finalised
ac: WOW 1 brief is finalised and agreed by the team

subIssues.title: Task 4: WOW 2 brief drafted and finalised
ac: WOW 2 brief is finalised and agreed by the team

subIssues.title: Task 4: WOW 3 brief drafted and finalised
ac: WOW 3 brief is finalised and agreed by the team

subIssues.title: Task 5: EOD update and site arc done
ac: EOD update is sent to the client
Site arc is mapped

issues.title: Day 2: Build
ac: All Day 2 sub-issues are closed

subIssues.title: Day 2: Internal plan of action held
ac: Day 2 plan is agreed, with an owner for each task

subIssues.title: Day 2: Vibe coding, wireframing and app build progressed
ac: Day 2 build progress is pushed and live on the Vercel link

subIssues.title: Day 2: EOD team and client update meeting held
ac: Day 2 EOD update meeting is held with the client

issues.title: Day 3: Build
ac: All Day 3 sub-issues are closed

subIssues.title: Day 3: Internal plan of action held
ac: Day 3 plan is agreed, with an owner for each task

subIssues.title: Day 3: Vibe coding, wireframing and app build progressed
ac: Day 3 build progress is pushed and live on the Vercel link

subIssues.title: Day 3: EOD team and client update meeting held
ac: Day 3 EOD update meeting is held with the client

issues.title: Day 4: Polish and POC summary
ac: All Day 4 sub-issues are closed

subIssues.title: Platform UI polished
ac: UI matches the branded component guide across all WOW screens

subIssues.title: WOW screens finished
ac: All 3 WOW screens work end to end on the Vercel link

subIssues.title: Feedback HTML set up
ac: Feedback HTML page is live and can be shared with the client

subIssues.title: EOD team and client update held (POC summary)
ac: POC summary is presented to the client

subIssues.title: Reflections shared with MVV Owner (Basecamp, email)
ac: Team reflections are sent to the MVV Owner on Basecamp or by email

milestones.name: Feedback
milestones.description: Final client presentation, post-hackathon pack, client feedback videos and feedback meeting.

issues.title: Final client presentation held (Monday)
ac: Final presentation is held with the client on Monday

issues.title: Post-hackathon pack and wrap-up meeting done
ac: Post-hackathon pack is shared with the client in the wrap-up meeting

issues.title: Client creates feedback videos and shares them
ac: The client's feedback videos are received by the team

issues.title: Feedback meeting held for questions, concerns and further feedback
ac: Feedback meeting is held and follow-up actions are logged

milestones.name: Design
milestones.description: Implement feedback and hold the final presentation (Friday).

issues.title: Team member implements feedback
ac: Each piece of client feedback is implemented, or has an agreed reason not to be

issues.title: Final presentation held (Friday)
ac: Updated designs are presented to the client on Friday

milestones.name: SOW / TDP
milestones.description: Developer creates the SOW and TDP; SOW and POC platform discussion (Friday).

issues.title: Developer creates SOW and TDP
ac: SOW and TDP are drafted and ready for review

issues.title: SOW and POC platform discussion held (Friday)
ac: SOW and POC platform are discussed on Friday and changes are agreed

issues.title: SOW discussion with client held
ac: SOW is discussed with the client and next steps are agreed
